tables.name: activities
tables.description: Activities (ACTS rows with an id). Dates are kept as the prototype's display strings plus ISO dates.

tables.name: activity_assignments
tables.description: Activity resource assignments (A1250_RES 3227).

tables.name: activity_events
tables.description: Cross-project activity feed (ACTIVITY 3557), newest first. Actors are persons or systems (Lucca, System, Sage X3).

tables.name: activity_links
tables.description: Logic links (`p` = [[predId, type, lag]] on the successor).

tables.name: allocations
tables.description: Weekly load of a person, % of available hours (PEOPLE[i][2]: 8 weeks from w/c 28 Sep 2026). The prototype holds one total per week (projectId null); project-level rows are allowed for later use. Pool membership and order: persons.resourcePoolPosition.

tables.name: app_settings
tables.description: Key / value settings ("health.thresholds" = { risk: 0.97, off: 0.9 }) with the last editor.

tables.name: assembly_links
tables.description: Product structure (TREE 3421): child × quantity per parent assembly, in drawing order.

tables.name: audit_entries
tables.description: Append-only audit trail (AUDIT 3572): who changed what, when — exportable for ISO 9001 audits.

tables.name: baseline_activities
tables.description: Activity snapshot of a baseline (11 §3.3 BaselineActivity). The seed snapshots BL1 of every project with planning data from the activities' BL1 finish (`bl`); BL0 and the proposed BL2 have no activity rows (the prototype keeps none). `activityId` is cleared if the activity is removed later — the code and name keep the snapshot readable.

tables.name: baselines
tables.description: Baselines (BASELINES 3504). BL2 is pending CR-009 (no set date yet).

tables.name: billing_plans
tables.description: Billing plan of a project (BILLING 3541): billing model and, for projects without a contract, the contract value of the legacy plan. Null value = read the contract (base + signed amendments).

tables.name: budget_change_lines
tables.description: Budget screen change list (projectData().CRS = HCRS 3193) — see the file header.

tables.name: calendar_exceptions
tables.description: Exceptions of one calendar: an extra non-working day (closure) or an exceptional working day (Saturday worked).

tables.name: calendars
tables.description: Work calendars. The four built-in ones (S-2: Standard 5d · 8h, Atelier 5d · 8h, Chantier 6d · 10h, Continu 24h / 7d) are seeded with the codes of `CalendarCode`; an MS Project / P6 import may add project calendars (`projectId` set). Projects reference a calendar by `projects.calendar`, activities by `activities.calendar_code` (codes, no foreign key: the DAL checks).

tables.name: capacity_demand_rates
tables.description: Demand per €1M of budget by department (capacity what-if: Engineering 140 h, Site 90, MEP 60, C&P 70, Quality 40).

tables.name: certifications
tables.description: Certifications (CERTS 3458, one free-text line per person split on " · "). Expiry tracked in Lucca.

tables.name: change_request_steps
tables.description: Approval chain (HLT_CRS_X.chain: pm, director, client, ccb).

tables.name: change_request_wbs
tables.description: WBS elements a change applies to (HLT_CRS_X.wbs), with the allocated amount when known.

tables.name: change_requests
tables.description: Change requests (HLT_CRS_X 3498 + CR-005 from HCRS).

tables.name: cities
tables.description: Cities used to resolve free-text sites (CITY_COUNTRY 3174, zoneOfSite).

tables.name: client_communications
tables.description: Client communication log (chapter 4, Site › "Client communication log"; Keystone-owned, per project): every exchange with the client — date, channel, contact, subject, summary — and its follow-up (owner, due date, done). Numbered COM-001… per project.

tables.name: client_document_categories
tables.description: Document categories shared with the client (CLIENT_DOCS 3543, HLT-026 × 5) — defined but not rendered by the prototype (L-9).

tables.name: client_issues
tables.description: Issues raised by the client (CLIENT_ISSUES 3544: CI-04, CI-06, CI-07 on HLT-026; new ones continue at CI-08).

tables.name: client_questions
tables.description: Internal ⇄ client question bridge (MTG_EXCHANGE 3712: HLT-026 × 3, NDC-031 × 2).

tables.name: clients
tables.description: Client organisations (CLIENT_CODES 3167 + clients cited by projects).

tables.name: closure_items
tables.description: Project closure checklist (CLOSURE 3733: HLT-026 × 10).

tables.name: commissioning_steps
tables.description: One cell of the commissioning grid: a system × step with its status and date or blocking reference ("Blocked · IF-02").

tables.name: commissioning_systems
tables.description: Systems commissioned on a project (COMMISSIONING.systems 3721: HLT-026 × 6).

tables.name: connector_sync_runs
tables.description: Synchronisations run from "Sync now" (simulated for connectors without an implementation).

tables.name: connectors
tables.description: Connectors to the systems of record (CONNECTORS 3570: 9) plus Vigie. Rows of kind `vigie` / `cursus` show the live state of Keystone's connector layer (src/server/integrations); the others keep the recorded state of their last sync.

tables.name: contingency_draws
tables.description: Draw-downs on the contingency (CONTINGENCY.draws; AF.contingency). Stored oldest first.

tables.name: contingency_registers
tables.description: Contingency provision of a project (CONTINGENCY 3720: HLT-026 initial 150 k€). Projects without a row use the default round(BAC × 3 %) (04 §5.3); the row is created on their first draw-down.

tables.name: contract_amendments
tables.description: Amendments (avenants). Only signed ones add to the contract value.

tables.name: contract_bonds
tables.description: Bonds and guarantees. In force unless released.

tables.name: contracts
tables.description: Client contract of a project (CONTRACTS 3713 — HLT-026 only). The contract sheet fields are editable.

tables.name: cost_categories
tables.description: Cost categories (HCAT_ROWS 3192 + HCATS 3112 / generated CAT_ROWS + CATS, same order).

tables.name: cost_streams
tables.description: Other cost streams (HLT_STREAMS 3098 / generated STREAMS): name + basis; monthly values when known.

tables.name: countries
tables.description: Countries → zone (COUNTRY_ZONE 3171).

tables.name: cursus_clearances
tables.description: Individual go / no go of the people mobilised on a project's site, as Cursus reports it.

tables.name: cursus_requests
tables.description: Outbox towards Cursus: "Remind in Cursus" on a person's pending approvals, travel requests (POST /demandes).

tables.name: cursus_sync_runs
tables.description: Cursus synchronisations (mock: the seed's "26 Sep 07:00"; HTTP: each go-no-go refresh).

tables.name: customer_invoices
tables.description: Customer invoices (1:1 with an invoiced milestone). Due date = issued + payment delay (derived, calendar days).

tables.name: daily_reports
tables.description: Daily site reports (SITE_REPORTS 3580 + reports saved with the "Daily report" form). Numbered per project (DR-001…) in date order; `linkRef` points to an NCR ("NCR-029") or nothing.

tables.name: deliverable_raci
tables.description: RACI-B of a deliverable: R produces, A signs off, C consulted, I informed, B backup (names as the register shows them).

tables.name: deliverables
tables.description: Deliverables (HLT_DELIVS 3515: HLT-026 × 10; the 5 other projects with data get the prototype's generated D-110…D-113 — HLT_DELIVS[0..3] with R = the project's PM). The prototype's `acc` text mixed acceptance and due information ("12 Mar · N. Bensaïd", "Accept by 2 Oct", "Issue 30 Sep", "25 Sep · comments issued"): it is split into dates and people below; the display text is derived (DAL `acceptanceText`).

tables.name: department_capacities
tables.description: Department capacity over the 8-week resource window (ROLES 3132).

tables.name: departments
tables.description: Departments (DEPTS 3268).

tables.name: document_acknowledgements
tables.description: Client acknowledgement of a released client-deliverable revision (`engOv.ack[id|rev]`). Absent row = pending.

tables.name: document_approvals
tables.description: Approval proof of the current revision: one row per circuit step (step 0 = originator, signed at issue).

tables.name: document_approver_assignments
tables.description: Named approver of a circuit role (DOC_WHO 3617 — global in the prototype; projectId reserved for per-project overrides).

tables.name: document_deposits
tables.description: Deposit hand-offs to Codex (`dv.dep`): a new document, or a new revision of an existing one.

tables.name: document_downloads
tables.description: Download log (`engOv.dl` + the Codex log).

tables.name: document_index_syncs
tables.description: Codex index synchronisations ("Last sync 08:02 · 412 records").

tables.name: document_links
tables.description: Relations of a document (`links`: [['Deliverable', 'D-016']]) — free references until the targets are modelled.

tables.name: document_revisions
tables.description: Revisions A … current (synthetic history in the seed: one revision every 21 days).

tables.name: document_type_circuit_steps
tables.description: Approval circuit of a type ("Author → Engineering lead → Project manager"): step 0 is the originator.

tables.name: document_types
tables.description: Document types register (DOC_TYPES 3615, 28 types) — read-only mirror of Codex.

tables.name: documents
tables.description: Index record of a Codex document (DOCS 3618, 42 records; deposits and meeting minutes created in Keystone).

tables.name: drawing_revisions
tables.description: Revision history of a drawing as the vault reports it. The prototype synthesises A…current (A–D only, `dwgVals` 4378): the current revision carries the check-in date and the ECO, older ones are "Superseded".

tables.name: drawings
tables.description: Drawings of the SolidWorks PDM vault linked to catalogue parts (DRAWINGS 3439, 13 rows) — a read-only mirror: revisions and states change in the vault (OPEN QUESTION E-7 for the sync contract).

tables.name: eng_changes
tables.description: Recent changes & impact (ENG_CHANGES 3743, HLT-026 × 4) and the changes recorded by imports in Keystone.

tables.name: eng_checks
tables.description: Inconsistencies detected at each import (ENG_CHECKS 3741, HLT-026 × 10, C-01…C-10).

tables.name: eng_column_mappings
tables.description: Column mapping of the import wizard (ENG_MAP 3745): source column → Keystone field.

tables.name: eng_consistency_rules
tables.description: Consistency rules between disciplines (ENG_RULES 3740): "process-elec" → "Process ↔ Electrical", "revision".

tables.name: eng_disciplines
tables.description: Disciplines and their referents (ENG_DISC 3736): Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Automation.

tables.name: eng_import_deltas
tables.description: Staged deltas the import wizard shows before importing (ENG_DELTAS 3746, the prototype's static check step).

tables.name: eng_import_tools
tables.description: Source tools of the import wizard (ENG_TOOLS 3744): "TIA Portal — PLC tag table" · Automation.

tables.name: eng_imports
tables.description: Imports run with the wizard ("Import · freeze this revision as input").

tables.name: eng_inputs
tables.description: Documents a discipline consumes (ENG_INPUTS 3739, HLT-026 × 12): the revision in use and whether the referent confirmed it. Internal documents are Codex records; external ones (the client's BOD-CLI-026) carry their provider. The state (up to date / to confirm / outdated) is derived from the provider document's latest released revision.

tables.name: eng_outputs
tables.description: Lists Keystone generates for the next service (ENG_OUTPUTS 3742, HLT-026 × 6). Blocked → Ready is derived.

tables.name: evm_periods
tables.description: Cumulative EVM series by month (HPV/HEV/HAC 3100–3103 / generated PV, EV, AC). PV covers 12 months; EV and AC stop at the data date (null afterwards).

tables.name: export_log
tables.description: Export log: every file produced by the export route (screen, format, filters, rows) — for the audit trail.

tables.name: goods_receipts
tables.description: Goods receipts / deliveries (HLT_DELIV 3468 + genDeliv 4449; announced in Keystone: BL-2026-0600…).

tables.name: handover_items
tables.description: Handover dossier (DOE) items (COMMISSIONING.dossier: HLT-026 × 8) with their Codex document type and document.

tables.name: hours_imports
tables.description: Monthly import of hours declared in Lucca on the project analytic code (HOURS 3735: HLT-026, September 2026).

tables.name: hours_lines
tables.description: Matched lines: resource × work package, planned vs declared hours.

tables.name: import_formats
tables.description: File import / export formats (IMPORTS 3571: 6).

tables.name: import_job_rows
tables.description: Preview rows of an import job (OK / warning / error with messages), replaced at each preview.

tables.name: import_jobs
tables.description: Import job (staging): upload → parse → (column mapping for Excel / CSV) → preview → explicit confirmation → transactional write. Nothing reaches the business tables before `applied`; a dry run stops at `previewed`.

tables.name: interventions
tables.description: Field interventions (INTERVENTIONS 3731: 6). The seed's type text "Corrective · WC-014" is split into type + claim.

tables.name: itp_inspections
tables.description: Inspections and tests of a plan ("I-03 Paint thickness (DFT)"); results are read-only (OPEN QUESTION Q-6).

tables.name: itp_plans
tables.description: A project's ITP (ITP 3717: HLT-026 only), built from the machine-type template (ITP_TEMPLATES 3716).

tables.name: job_title_rates
tables.description: Legacy rate per job title (RATES 3262) — only the Task screen's cost note uses it (OPEN QUESTION A-10).

tables.name: leave_entries
tables.description: Approved absences mirrored from Lucca (LEAVE 3459, week-indexed in the prototype → one row per week).

tables.name: leave_types
tables.description: Leave types with the working days lost in a week (LEAVE_DAYS 3460).

tables.name: lessons_learned
tables.description: Lessons learned (LESSONS 3732: HLT-026 × 4; lessons recorded in Keystone continue at LL-10).

tables.name: lifecycle_stages
tables.description: Lifecycle stages (STATUSES 3136, LIFE 3148, GATES 3147, ST_SHORT 3905).

tables.name: lifecycle_transitions
tables.description: Allowed transitions (TRANS 3146): next stage in order, or 'annule'; none from Clos / Annulé.

tables.name: machine_part_revisions
tables.description: As-maintained configuration: the revision of each tracked part fitted on a machine (AS_MAINT 3722: 6 machines).

tables.name: machine_type_cost_categories
tables.description: Reference cost categories of a machine type, k€ (NP_TEMPLATES[mt].cats).

tables.name: machine_type_itp_systems
tables.description: ITP inspection systems of a machine type (ITP_TEMPLATES 3716) — the systems of a project's inspection plan.

tables.name: machine_type_phases
tables.description: Standard phases of a machine type (NP_TEMPLATES[mt].phases; edited on the Machine types screen).

tables.name: machine_types
tables.description: Machine types (MACHINE_TYPES 3166) with the REX payment pattern (REX_FIN 3101).

tables.name: machines
tables.description: Machines in service (FLEET 3729: 8; machines added in Keystone continue at MCH-050). The zone is derived from the site's city (cities → countries → zones), else the delivering project's zone, else Europe & North America.

tables.name: meeting_agenda_points
tables.description: Agenda points (`agenda[].pt`).

tables.name: meeting_lines
tables.description: Minutes lines per agenda point: info / decision / action (owner, due, done, task created on "Send minutes").

tables.name: meeting_participants
tables.description: Invitees, attendance and read receipts of the minutes (`invited`, `present`, `read`).

tables.name: meeting_transcript_proposals
tables.description: Decisions and actions proposed by the transcript analysis.

tables.name: meeting_transcripts
tables.description: Meeting transcript (MTG_TRANSCRIPTS 3711) and its analysis. The analysis is simulated (OPEN QUESTION S-10): the prototype's pre-baked summary and proposals are stored with the transcript and revealed by "Analyse transcript".

tables.name: meetings
tables.description: Meetings (MEETINGS 3703: HLT-026 × 5, NDC-031 × 1).

tables.name: milestones
tables.description: Milestones (HMILES 3122 / generated MILES). Months are fractional offsets from the project start.

tables.name: mission_cost_lines
tables.description: Mission cost lines charged to the Site work package (SITE_COSTS 3579), k€.

tables.name: notification_recipients
tables.description: Delivery of a notification to a user, with the per-user read state (replaces `state.readNotifs`).

tables.name: notifications
tables.description: Notifications (NOTIFS 3545). The prototype addresses them to roles (`audience`); each one is expanded into notification_recipients rows for the users holding those roles, which carry the per-user read state.

tables.name: offer_quotes
tables.description: Commercial-offer supplier quotes (HLT_OFFER 3097 / generated OFFER). Months index chartMonths.

tables.name: part_equivalents
tables.description: Registered equivalents (`PARTS.equiv`), one row per direction as the catalogue lists them.

tables.name: part_last_prices
tables.description: Last purchase price (LAST_PRICE 3428, 15 parts); `lastPrice(p)` falls back to the list price.

tables.name: parts
tables.description: Catalogue articles (PARTS 3343, 54 rows; `pu` from WEAR_SPARE 3341).

tables.name: payment_milestones
tables.description: Payment milestones: contractual ones (`contractId` set — share of the contract value, contractual date, status) and the legacy billing-plan rows of projects without a contract (fixed amount, no date).

tables.name: pdm_vault_syncs
tables.description: PDM vault synchronisations ("Last vault sync 07:40", "Drawings in vault 1 248"; Sync vault form AF.drawings).

tables.name: person_skills
tables.description: Level 0–5 of a person on a skill (SKILL_LV 3457; 0 = none).

tables.name: persons
tables.description: Staff and external contacts (PEOPLE, OWN, PERSONAS, DEPTS heads, zone managers, ENG_DISC leads, DOC_WHO and the project managers cited by projects). Some are only known by their short name ("S. Perrin").

tables.name: pid_sheets
tables.description: P&ID sheet under validation (PID 3583, HLT-026): the Codex record it belongs to and the revision the tags were extracted from (rev C, Under review — Codex has rev D released, 11 §7 #10, OPEN QUESTION A-9).

tables.name: pid_tags
tables.description: Tags of the P&ID (PID_TAGS 3585, 24) and their mapping to a project BOM reference (`pidOv`). Status is derived.

tables.name: pid_validation_steps
tables.description: Process validation steps (PID_STEPS 3611): tags extracted → mapping → overlay agreed → review → released for construction.

tables.name: pipeline_stage_plans
tables.description: Pipeline stage plan (PIPE_PLAN 3665): windows in month offsets from Jan 2026.

tables.name: po_lines
tables.description: Order lines (`lines: [ref, ordered qty, received qty]`).

tables.name: portfolio_cash_forecasts
tables.description: Portfolio cash forecast, next 6 months (CASH_M 3542 with the prototype's cash-in / cash-out arrays, logic 4518): planning figures in k€ for the whole portfolio, scaled by zone share on screen. OPEN QUESTION C-10: derive cash-in from the billing plan and cash-out from the forecast spend.

tables.name: portfolio_scores
tables.description: Score 1–5 of a project on an axis (SCORES 3540, obsolete codes remapped; for `risk`, 5 = low risk).

tables.name: project_assembly_roots
tables.description: Multi-level structure configured for a project (`TREES = {HLT: TREE}` 3426): root assembly × quantity.

tables.name: project_bom_lines
tables.description: Project BOM lines (`PARTS.usage {p3: qty}` 3343; Add article form AF.bom). One line per part and project; the quantity is the total in the project (assemblies and their components are both listed, as the prototype does — valuations must not add both, 09 OQ6).

tables.name: project_controls
tables.description: Project control header — the figures and display strings of projectData() (HLT_PD 3308 / generated, docs/spec/05 §0.5, 04 §1.8) for projects with planning data. `chartMonths`/`ganttMonths` derive from `startMonth`, `p3` from the project short code, `pct` from progress and BAC from the project budget.

tables.name: project_interfaces
tables.description: Interfaces owed by the client or third parties (INTERFACES 3719: HLT-026 × 7). The stored status is open / received / frozen; "Late" is derived (open and needed before the prototype's now, PG_NOW).

tables.name: project_members
tables.description: Project team (DEFS[code].team).

tables.name: project_sites
tables.description: Project site (GEO 3169). Zone = zoneOverride ?? country zone.

tables.name: project_templates
tables.description: New-project templates (NP_TEMPLATES 3179, incl. 'blank'; NP_TEMPLATES_OLD is ignored). French data.

tables.name: projects
tables.description: Projects (PROJECTS/META/STAGE_OF + EXTRA via initialProjects 3163, PROJ_ID 3168).

tables.name: public_holidays
tables.description: Public holidays (SETTINGS0.holidays 3467, France 2026; HOLIDAYS 3461 = those on a weekday of the 8-week window).

tables.name: punch_items
tables.description: Punch items (réserves). One entity for the ITP punch list (PUNCH 3718, categorised A/B/C) and the Site punch list (SITE_PUNCH 3581, owner party and NCR); their seed ids and statuses clash (11 §7 #4, OPEN QUESTION A-6), so each item belongs to a register and is numbered per register.

tables.name: purchase_orders
tables.description: Purchase orders (HLT_POS 3406 + genPOs 3415 per project with data; drafts from the BOM shortfall assistant and RFQ awards). Value = Σ line qty × line unit price (derived).

tables.name: raci_cells
tables.description: Non-empty cells (empty = no row).

tables.name: raci_columns
tables.description: Matrix columns ("Project manager", "Client PM", "Port HSE"…).

tables.name: raci_matrices
tables.description: RACI matrix of a project (RACI 3715: HLT-026, 6 columns × 7 rows). Columns are dynamic.

tables.name: raci_rows
tables.description: Matrix rows (responsibilities: "Design release (BPE)").

tables.name: rate_multipliers
tables.description: Premium multipliers (MULTS 3455).

tables.name: rate_roles
tables.description: Hourly cost rate per role (RATE_ROLES 3454). Visible to director and pm only (enforced by the screen).

tables.name: receipt_attachments
tables.description: Receipt documents (delivery note, certificates: `docs[]`) and photos (`photos` count; file names unknown in the seed).

tables.name: receipt_lines
tables.description: Receipt lines (`lines: [ref, ordered, delivered, accepted, rejected, location]`).

tables.name: reference_values
tables.description: Company reference lists edited in Settings (SETTINGS0 3467): skills 10, cost categories 6, project statuses 13, risk categories 7, deliverable types 8, public holidays 11, location types 5. "Remove" deactivates the value (records that use it keep their code, OPEN QUESTION A-14); "Reset to defaults" restores the seed list.

tables.name: request_activity_choices
tables.description: Activities offered by the "New resource request" dialog of a project (NR_ACTS 3283 for HLT-026: A1250, A1260, A1320, A1420, A1430 — a curated list). Projects without choices offer their open activities (DAL).

tables.name: resource_request_events
tables.description: Decision trail of a request (seeded from `sent` and the `response` text).

tables.name: resource_requests
tables.description: Resource requests (REQUESTS 3270): a PM asks a department for a person or a contract role on an activity.

tables.name: revision_diff_lines
tables.description: Lines of a revision comparison ("ASM-DRV-700 / EL-VFD-200" 2 → 3, Quantity).

tables.name: revision_diffs
tables.description: Revision comparison of an assembly (REV_DIFF 3427: ASM-RMG-250 rev B → C, 12 Sep 2026, ECO-2026-014).

tables.name: rex_references
tables.description: REX references of a machine type (REX_FIN[mt].refs).

tables.name: rfq_quotes
tables.description: Supplier quotes of an RFQ (`quotes: [supplier, unit price €, lead weeks, terms, grade, score]`).

tables.name: rfqs
tables.description: Requests for quotation (RFQS 3526; New RFQ form AF.procurement).

tables.name: risks
tables.description: Risk register (RISKS_HLT 3487 for HLT-026; the 5 other projects with data get the prototype's generated register: RISKS_HLT[0..3] renumbered R-01…R-04, owned by the project PM, EMV scaled to the BAC). Score, level and "contingency draw if it occurs" are derived (codes.ts riskScore / riskLevelOf / riskCostIfOccurs).

tables.name: sat_plans
tables.description: SAT plans recorded with "Plan SAT" (AF.commissioning: system, date, client witnesses, prerequisites).

tables.name: satisfaction_scores
tables.description: Customer-satisfaction survey (SATISFACTION 3734: HLT-026 × 5 criteria, 0–5 by 0.5).

tables.name: schedule_bars
tables.description: Schedule bars (HTASKS 3113 / generated TASKS): one bar per work package, as shown on the Schedule screen. Kept as data (golden values) — not recomputed from the activities (OPEN QUESTION A-7).

tables.name: schedule_runs
tables.description: "Reschedule" runs (S-1: manual, like F9 in P6): what changed, for the toast, the audit and "a second run changes nothing".

tables.name: score_axes
tables.description: Scoring axes (SCORE_AXES 3539) with their default weight.

tables.name: score_weights
tables.description: Weights edited on the Prioritisation screen (`pfWeights`), per user (scope OPEN QUESTION L-5). Absent = default.

tables.name: site_collisions
tables.description: Collisions detected on the site team (SITE_COLLISIONS 3578): load, certificate, document, leave.

tables.name: site_equipment
tables.description: Equipment on site (SITE_EQUIP 3575: shipped with the machine, rented locally, provided by the client).

tables.name: site_prerequisites
tables.description: Client prerequisites (SITE_PREREQ 3576): dated and signed by the client, each one conditions a site activity.

tables.name: site_rotations
tables.description: Site team rotation plan (SITE_ROTATION 3577): who, role on site, mission dates, lodging, travel, rotation.

tables.name: site_sheets
tables.description: Site sheet of a project (SITE 3573: HLT-026 only). Values are authored in French in the prototype ("Lun–Sam 7h–19h…") and kept as data. `cursusChantierId` is the site's id in Cursus ("K-2614"), used by the HTTP Cursus connector — null in the seed: OPEN QUESTION C-3, how Keystone projects map to Cursus chantiers (Cursus numbers them K-26xx).

tables.name: skills
tables.description: Skill families (SKILLS 3456; matrix column order).

tables.name: spare_list_lines
tables.description: Recommended wear & spare parts of a system (SPARE_LISTS 3399): quantity per system; recommended = × systems in the project.

tables.name: stage_deliverable_checks
tables.description: Ticked stage deliverables (STAGE_DONE_DEFAULT 3141). Absent row = not done.

tables.name: stage_deliverable_defs
tables.description: Exit deliverables of each stage (STAGE_DELIVS 3140, French labels).

tables.name: stage_transitions
tables.description: Stage history (STAGE_HISTORY 3142): one row per stage entered, auto or forced.

tables.name: stakeholders
tables.description: Stakeholder register (STAKEHOLDERS 3714: HLT-026 × 8). Stale when the last contact is more than 30 days old.

tables.name: status_reports
tables.description: Status reports generated from the Trends screen (AF.trends — the prototype only toasts, nothing is seeded).

tables.name: status_snapshots
tables.description: Weekly status snapshots frozen at each Friday status date (HLT_SNAPS 3486 × SNAP_WEEKS 3485 / SNAP_DATES 4566 for HLT-026; the 5 other projects with data get the prototype's generated linear series, 04 §2.6).

tables.name: stock_movements
tables.description: Stock movements (MOVES0 3484 + movements recorded in Keystone).

tables.name: stock_positions
tables.description: Stock positions (STOCK0 3475, 18 lines). Available = on hand − reserved; value = on hand × last purchase price; below minimum = min > 0 ∧ on hand < min (all derived).

tables.name: storage_locations

tables.name: stored_files
tables.description: A file kept by Keystone under <data dir>/files (`storagePath` is relative to that folder). `ownerType` / `ownerId` say what it is attached to ('task_attachment', 'meeting_transcript', 'import_job'…); deleting the owner deletes the row and the file through the storage module.

tables.name: supplier_invoices
tables.description: Supplier invoices (INVOICES 3531) checked against the order and the goods receipt (3-way match `match3` 4663). The PO and receipt amounts are the values the match compares; the receipt amount follows the accepted quantities once the receipt is decided in Keystone.

tables.name: suppliers
tables.description: Suppliers and manufacturers: the 8 companies of the supplier scorecard (SUPPLIERS 3538) plus every other company the data set cites — part manufacturers (`PARTS.mfr`, incl. Keystone's own workshops), RFQ bidders, invoice issuers. The scorecard fields are null for companies that are not rated.

tables.name: vigie_eco_approvals
tables.description: Approval keys of an ECO and their state in Vigie (englead, quality, pm).

tables.name: vigie_eco_effectivity
tables.description: Effectivity as Vigie reports it (read-only): every target — project BOM or machine of the installed base — with its disposition (null = pending). Keystone reads it for the stock and PU/PR "keep for the installed base" warnings, the part record and the ECO list; dispositions are decided in Vigie.

tables.name: vigie_eco_parts
tables.description: Parts an ECO affects, by catalogue reference (`parts[]`).

tables.name: vigie_eco_progress
tables.description: Outbox of the progress recorded in Keystone on a Vigie ECO: the viewer's decision on their approval key, or a step advancement. Each entry stays "pending sync with Vigie" until the connector delivers it; Vigie then updates the ECO and the next refresh brings the result into the mirror.

tables.name: vigie_eco_projects
tables.description: Projects an ECO is declared for, by Keystone project code (`projects[]` 3-letter keys resolved: HLT → HLT-026).

tables.name: vigie_ecos
tables.description: ECOs as Vigie reports them (seed: the prototype's ECOS 3432 with their derived status, 6 rows).

tables.name: vigie_hse_items
tables.description: Site HSE register as Vigie reports it (SITE_HSE 3582, HLT-026 × 5). Read-only in Keystone: prevention plans and permits are issued and signed in Vigie ("Manage in Vigie"); incidents are declared there ("Report in Vigie").

tables.name: vigie_ncr_progress
tables.description: Outbox of the progress recorded in Keystone on a Vigie NCR: a step advancement ("→ Root cause"), or the quality verification (approve → Closed, reject → back to Corrective action). Stays "pending sync with Vigie" until delivered; the NCR's status changes in Keystone only when Vigie reports it.

tables.name: vigie_ncrs
tables.description: Project NCRs as Vigie reports them (seed: HLT_NCRS 3507 for HLT-026 and the prototype's generated NCR-040 / NCR-041 — HLT_NCRS[1..2] without activity, part or deliverable — for the 5 other projects with data). Read-only: creation, severity, causes, actions, cost and due dates are managed in Vigie; Keystone records the viewer's step decisions in `vigie_ncr_progress`. NCR numbers are unique per project, as the prototype numbered them.
